note_on_network_naming: The Graph's supported-networks docs list TWO unrelated networks both called 'Arc': a mainnet entry (chain eip155:5042, docs.arc.network — a different project) and a testnet entry ('arc-testnet', chain eip155:5042002, docs.arc.network link is likely a doc error — the chain id is the definitive match to Circle's Arc Testnet, confirmed by BoltRegistry's real deployment). Studio's onboarding UI just labels the testnet option 'Arc'.

https://thegraph.com/docs/ — Subgraph Studio deploy flow (graph auth / graph deploy), since subgraphs-skills doesn't cover Studio deployment mechanics
real_bug_found_and_fixed: `class` is a reserved word in AssemblyScript. graph-cli's codegen silently renames the generated entity/event-param accessor to `class_` in compiled mapping code, while the public GraphQL schema field stays plain `class`. The mappings and the GraphQL client each needed the correct one — mixing them up compiles/queries but returns nothing.
